integrity_notes: An analytic proof is provided, checked separately against numerical Gaussian-mixture bounds; no independent scientific audit or publication certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two strictly positive stiffnesses are required; the soft-stiffness zero limit is singular and is excluded.
Finite-mean Pareto-type soft sojourn survival and a fixed positive stiff sojourn are required.
This is an infinite-displacement density equivalent; convergence may be very slow in displacement.
The theorem does not establish finite-data identifiability or priority over all unindexed literature.
title: Logarithmically weakened Gaussian tails under heavy-tailed switching between two confining traps
